tools.name: find_house
tools.description: Look up a Vancouver address, a street, a building's name or a resident's surname from 1945 or earlier in AddressLore's coverage. Returns the matching house's path for house_history; the candidates when the address could be on more than one street ("which street") or matches more than one old address

tools.name: house_history
tools.description: When a covered Vancouver house was built and what stood there: the building permit (1901–1930) and the City's year built, what the 1912 fire insurance map draws on the lot and whether today's building is very likely that one, what stands today, and who lived there in each directory year with each li

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: The Vancouver local areas, streets, blocks and directory years AddressLore covers: every directory year read with names (each area's extra years said), the years read for the whole city, the later years that hold buildings and places only, and the census years, with each local area's count of street

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_house" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up a Vancouver address, or a resident's surname from 1945 or earlier, in AddressLore's coverage. Returns the matching house's path for house_history, or says plainly that the address isn't covered (never a nearby house in its place), with the covered streets." → after: "Look up a Vancouver address, a street, a building's name or a resident's surname from 1945 or earlier in AddressLore's coverage. Returns the matching house's path for house_history; the candidates when the address could be on more than one street ("which street") or matches more than one old address"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
